title: Derived pullback preserves canonical tensor symmetry
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, g : X → Y a morphism of schemes, and K,M arbitrary objects of the ordinary unbounded derived category of Λ-module sheaves on the small etale site of Y [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write σ for the canonical signed symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym] and t_g for the canonical derived tensor comparison [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. Then Lg*(σ_{K,M}) followed by t_g(M,K) equals t_g(K,M) followed by σ_{Lg*K,Lg*M}. No boundedness, finiteness, or constructibility hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Use DerivedCategory.canonicalTensorSymmetry to package the existing derived braiding before specializing to the sheaf category. Its equality with the original localization construction is reflexive; the generic package selects the named derived braided instance, with the current braidedCategory' name and the prior braidedCategory name as an elaboration fallback for the published build. The localization package spells out the existing braiding isomorphism fields, avoiding dependency on renamed wrapper constants. The upstream leftDerivedUpperStar_map_braiding_hom_δ now specializes directly to the stated equation: its comonoidal delta is leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison. No new derived compatibility assumption is needed.

theorem derivedPullback_tensorSymmetry
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (K M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
        (((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Y).hom.app K).app M) ≫
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison _ g).app M).app K =
    ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison _ g).app K).app M ≫
      ((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).hom.app
        (L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K)).app
          (L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj M)
